record.context_brief: Finite regular bands in semigroup rings
record.original_question: Given a finite left regular band or finite right regular band B, is the skew lattice generated by B inside the semigroup ring Z(B) necessarily finite?

evidence.quote: Given a finite left (right) regular band B, must the skew lattice generated from B in the semigroup ring Z(B) be finite also?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B$ be a finite band (i.e., a semigroup in which every element is idempotent) that is either left regular (satisfying $xyx = xy$ for all $x,y \in B$) or right regular (satisfying $xyx = yx$ for all $x,y \in B$). Consider the integral semigroup ring $\mathbb{Z}(B)$, whose elements are finite $\mathbb{Z}$-linear combinations of elements of $B$ with multiplication induced from $B$. Inside $\mathbb{Z}(B)$, the multiplication $\cdot$ of the ring and the operation $x \nabla y := x + y - xy$ (when restricted to suitable idempotent elements) generate a skew lattice: namely the smallest subset of $\mathbb{Z}(B)$ containing $B$ that is closed under both the ring multiplication and $\nabla$, and forms a skew lattice (a set with two associative, idempotent, mutually absorbing band operations $\wedge$ and $\vee$ satisfying the absorption identities $x \wedge (x \vee y) = x = x \vee (x \wedge y)$ and their duals). 

Question: Must the skew lattice generated by $B$ inside $\mathbb{Z}(B)$ be finite?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is recorded as an open problem from the NCS 2018 workshop. Searches did not surface any subsequent publication resolving whether the skew lattice generated by a finite left or right regular band inside its integral semigroup ring is necessarily finite. Related literature on skew lattices arising from regular bands in rings exists, but no source explicitly settles this specific finiteness question.

status_evidence.title: Open problems from NCS 2018
status_evidence.snippet: Document listing open problems including the finiteness of skew lattices generated by finite regular bands in their semigroup rings.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open problem from NCS 2018.

status_evidence.title: Linear Algebra and its Applications 426 (2007) 204–213
status_evidence.snippet: Studies regular bands occurring as multiplicative subsemigroups of rings and the skew lattices they generate.
status_evidence.claim: Background literature studies skew lattices generated by regular bands in rings, but does not resolve the finiteness question.

status_evidence.title: Thin MC left regular bands
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on left regular bands; does not appear to resolve the finiteness question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on left regular bands does not appear to settle the problem.
